**Word Table Column Resizing Steps:**

1. Click the table to select it.
2. Go to the Table Design tab in the ribbon.
3. Click Table Properties (far right of the ribbon).
4. Select the Table tab in the dialog box.
5. Click Options.
6. Uncheck "Allow spacing between cells" if checked.
7. Check "Automatically resize to fit contents" or set fixed column widths.
8. Click OK twice to apply and close the dialogs.

**Word Table Column Border Fix:**

1. Click anywhere in your table to activate the Table Design tab
2. Locate the "Table" group on the ribbon and click "Properties"
3. In the Table Properties dialog, select the "Table" tab
4. Check the box labeled "Preferred width" and set it to a fixed measurement
5. Click "OK" to apply—this locks the overall table width
6. When you now drag a column border, it will resize only that column without affecting others
